verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent machine-readable API spec. A probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing features, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
